slides.headline: "Repent" is a word that puts people off.
It sounds like a man with a sign.
body: Shouting. Angry. Certain you're the problem.

slides.headline: Not grovel. Not perform.
body: Think differently about who is running your life, and then live like you mean it.

slides.headline: 27 July 1987.
body: He knows the day he changed his mind. He has been walking it out ever since.

slides.headline: "I stopped walking in the wilderness of Christianity."
body: His phrase, not ours. He means going through the motions while looking sideways at everyone else.

slides.headline: You can be in church for years and still be out there.
body: Present every Sunday. Never actually decided anything.

slides.headline: It starts with a change of mind.
body: Not a change of behaviour first. That follows.
You can do it today, where you are, without telling anyone.
slides.kicker: Nobody has to know but you and God.
